question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
SELECT pt.topping_name, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM word_list w 
        WHERE (CASE WHEN SPLIT_PART(pt.topping_name, ' ', 2) = '' 
              THEN LOWER(w.words) LIKE '%' || LOWER(SPLIT_PART(pt.topping_name, ' ', 1)) || '%'
              ELSE LOWER(w.words) LIKE '%' || LOWER(SPLIT_PART(pt.topping_name, ' ', 1)) || '%'
                   OR LOWER(w.words) LIKE '%' || LOWER(SPLIT_PART(pt.topping_name, ' ', 2)) || '%'
              END)) as TOTAL_QUANTITY
FROM pizza_toppings pt
ORDER BY pt.topping_name
